# LingoVela: Live Translate

> Live two-way voice translation on iPhone and iPad. Hear replies, read both languages and use supported offline models. Subscription required.

LingoVela is a translation app in preparation for App Store release, published by Arte Soft EOOD for iPhone and iPad. The public App Store release is being prepared; contact Arte Soft for current availability. All translation modes require an active subscription: LingoVela Plus Monthly ($9.99/month in the US, including 2,000 AI credits each month) or LingoVela Plus Yearly ($79.99/year in the US, including 48,000 AI credits per annual payment — equivalent to 4,000 credits/month, 2× the monthly credit rate while saving 33% vs monthly billing; no free trial). Optional consumable top-up packs add 1,000 AI credits ($4.99) or 5,000 AI credits ($19.99). OpenAI Online and Private Cloud Compute use internet and AI credits. On Device uses compatible prepared translation and speech assets and no AI credits. Private Cloud Compute requires compatible Apple Intelligence hardware and iOS 27+. The product is not a telephone bridge, meeting plugin or certified interpreting service. Guide comparisons are published by its developer and are not independent benchmarks.

- [LingoVela Pricing: Plans, AI Credits & Offline Mode](https://lingovela.arte-soft.com/articles/understand-subscriptions-and-credits/): Transparent breakdown of LingoVela pricing ($9.99/mo or $79.99/yr), how online AI credits work, and how On-Device offline translation uses zero credits.
- [Vietnamese & Thai Live Voice Translator on iPhone](https://lingovela.arte-soft.com/articles/vietnamese-and-thai-english-voice-translator-iphone-guide/): Navigate Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Bangkok & Chiang Mai on iPhone: tonal accuracy, street noise, polite particles, and allergy verification.
